description: Demolition of existing tile roof and installation of Colorbond metal deck roofing to single-storey dwelling, including new gutters and downpipes.
rawScopeText: Re-roof: remove 180sqm concrete tile, install Colorbond Trimdek 0.42 BMT in Surfmist. New 100mm Quad gutters, 90mm round downpipes. Sarking R1.3, anticon under battens. Two replacement skylights.

description: Replacement of existing roofing including removal of asbestos cement sheeting and installation of new Colorbond metal roof.
rawScopeText: Asbestos removal under licensed Class B contractor. 220sqm replacement with Colorbond Kliplok 700 in Monument. Full sarking, ridge caps, new fascia. Two-day install once asbestos clearance issued.

description: Re-roof of two-storey residential dwelling — removal of existing terracotta tiles, installation of Colorbond Ultra metal roofing.
rawScopeText: 320sqm replacement, Colorbond Ultra in Wallaby. Full removal of existing terracotta, new 50x50 hardwood battens. Includes whirlybird ventilators (4 units). Premium finish, 25-year warranty.

description: Office fitout — partition walls, new flooring, and electrical upgrades. No structural work.
rawScopeText: Internal Class 5 fitout, no roofing scope. Two private offices, open-plan area, kitchenette.

description: Reroof and minor additions — replace metal roof and add new pergola structure to rear.
rawScopeText: Existing 1980s metal deck roof to be replaced with Colorbond Trimdek in Basalt, 145sqm. Plus new 24sqm steel-framed pergola with translucent polycarb roofing.

description: Heritage restoration — replacement of slate roofing tiles to maintain heritage character of c.1910 Federation cottage.
rawScopeText: Slate tile replacement using Welsh blue-grey slates to match existing. Heritage-grade copper flashings, lead-lined valleys. Approx 180sqm. Conservation overlay applies.

description: Roof replacement following storm damage — like-for-like Colorbond replacement to coastal dwelling.
rawScopeText: Insurance claim. 168sqm Colorbond Kliplok 406 in Surfmist with marine-grade ULTRA spec for coastal exposure. Full sarking and anticon, 50sqm replaced battens. Storm damage assessment attached.

description: New residential dwelling — single-storey 4-bedroom home, including roof framing and Colorbond metal roof installation.
rawScopeText: New build CDC. 195sqm Colorbond Trimdek roof in Monument. Full timber truss frame. Skylights x3 (1.2m x 1m). Solar-ready penetrations. Marine-grade fixings (coastal).

description: Strata roof refurbishment — re-roofing of 12-unit residential complex, replacing existing concrete tiles with Colorbond.
rawScopeText: Strata committee approved. 720sqm total roof area across 4 separate roof planes. Colorbond Trimdek in Surfmist. Full sarking, anticon. Sequenced 4-week install. Body corp insurance required.

description: Change of use from retail to small bar — interior fitout only, no external work.
rawScopeText: Class 6 to Class 9b change of use. Acoustic separation, kitchen extraction, accessible WC. No roofing scope.

description: Roof restoration and waterproofing — clean, repair, recoat existing concrete tile roof.
rawScopeText: Pressure clean, replace 8 broken tiles, re-bed and re-point ridge caps, apply 3-coat membrane (primer + colour + sealer). 140sqm. Restoration only — not a re-roof.

description: Two-storey alterations and additions — first floor extension over existing dwelling, new metal roof to extension and existing.
rawScopeText: First-floor addition 95sqm. Whole-of-roof replacement to match — 280sqm Colorbond Trimdek in Wallaby. Demolish existing tile roof, new trusses, sarking, anticon. Skylights x2 to bathrooms.
